experiment: P5s detached-supervised deterministic-chunk checkpointed shared frozen-forward execution
research_question: Can the unchanged P5e output-equivalent shared-forward cost protocol survive host-session interruption using a detached supervisor and 630-position analytic checkpoints?
single_changed_axis: Execution durability only: replace P5r's interactive-host launch and pool-scale analytic checkpoint with a detached child supervisor and deterministic analytic chunks. No model, feature, input, batch, timing, threshold, audit or gate changes.

historical_baseline_audit.rule: explicit baseline and every locally retained generated train MAT must be readable; overlap and unreadable counts must be zero

development_data.roles: evaluation-only; no training, selection, calibration or threshold adjustment
development_data.identity_rule: zero overlap with the explicit baseline and every locally retained generated train identity, including quarantined P5p/P5q/P5r

execution.benchmark_batch: first complete index-ordered batch, indices 0 through 125
execution.reference: two frozen base forwards plus unchanged dense attachment
execution.candidate: one frozen base forward plus identical unchanged dense attachment

detached_chunk_contract.analytic_chunk_rule: chunks preserve original Dataset position order; each internal feature batch remains 126 positions; completed chunks are SHA-256 validated and are never selectively recomputed
detached_chunk_contract.recovery_rule: only started chunks without a completed receipt may recompute, without inspecting unavailable output metrics; completed model/timing units never rerun
detached_chunk_contract.supervisor_rule: supervisor must record start, child PID and terminal exit receipt; child uses a detached Windows process group

checkpoint_contract.selection_prohibition: No completed timing/model unit may be selectively rerun.
checkpoint_contract.self_test: no-data/no-CUDA chunk round-trip, protocol relocation, explicit-baseline hash and detached-supervisor child-terminal tests all pass before data generation

authorized_environment.fallback_if_windows_driver_rejects_mode_: unchanged P5h process-level guard at launch, after every analytic chunk, around every equivalence/timing call and after execution

stop_rule: Any failed audit, protocol/chunk/supervisor test, baseline hash mismatch, external Python CUDA process, missing supervisor terminal receipt, hash mismatch, output non-equivalence or latency failure stops P5s; no P5s identity reuse or tuning.

confirmation_if_and_only_if_development_.decision: Only confirmation supports the narrow output-equivalent frozen-execution latency claim.
